supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible lateral extension beyond the outer eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: low contrast with muzzle area appearing slightly lighter than the periocular region

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: apparent permanent closure or structural anomaly of the right eye (viewer's left)
other_distinctive_markers: pronounced horizontal interlacing artifacts across the entire image
